ترتقبن (form VIII)
# تَرْتَقِبْنَ (tartaqibna) /tar.ta.qib.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# تُرْتَقَبْنَ (turtaqabna) /tur.ta.qab.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
